description: This file defines the MqttClientConfig class, which encapsulates configuration settings for an MQTT client, including SSL context, client ID, protocol version, reconnect logic, and retransmission settings.

classes.name: MqttClientConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for MQTT client settings, including SSL, client ID, protocol version, reconnect behavior, message size, and retransmission parameters.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID, generating a random one if null.

methods.name: setTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Sets the timeout duration in seconds, with validation.

methods.name: setProtocolVersion
methods.description: Sets the MQTT protocol version, throws if null.

methods.name: setReconnectDelay
methods.description: Sets the delay before reconnecting, with validation.

methods.name: setMaxBytesInMessage
methods.description: Sets the maximum message size in bytes, with validation.
